selected_script.angle: Organizing messy baking extract bottles and decorating tools by transferring them from cluttered pantry shelves to the side of the refrigerator
selected_script.hook: Stop knocking over your tiny baking extract bottles every time you reach into your pantry.

video_001_part_01.visual: 0-3s: Close-up of a hand reaching into a cluttered cabinet, accidentally knocking over several tiny baking extract bottles. 3-6s: Hand snaps a matte black rectangular metal magnetic rack onto the side of a refrigerator and arranges the bottles. 6-10s: Close-up of the rack holding baking bottles neatly, with measuring spoons hanging from the bottom hooks.
video_001_part_01.audio: Stop knocking over your tiny baking extract bottles every time you reach into your pantry. Get them organized instantly with this heavy-duty magnetic rack.

video_001_part_02.visual: 0-4s: A lower matching matte black rack holds sprinkle jars and cupcake tins. 4-8s: Handheld shot panning over both organized racks looking completely clean and tidy. 8-10s: On-screen text CTA reads 'Upgrade your kitchen organization today.'
video_001_part_02.audio: It holds up to 11 lbs and keeps everything within reach. Upgrade your kitchen organization today.
